title: Job Application and CV / Batanin aikin da CV
bridge: A cikin yare na Turanci, muna yin 'I have 25 years' ko 'I am a graduate in Tourism', amma a cikin turanci, fasaha ta canje. Muna yin amfani da 'to have' da 'in' ko 'from' a matsayin preposition. Da fatan za a duba yin amfani da 'experience' (ba 'experiences' a cikin yanayin yanzu ba) da kiyaye yadda ake sa adijectives a gaba da nouns, wanda a turanci ya zama dole. Kada ka canza 'me dedico a' da 'I dedicate myself to' saboda ya dace da fasaha mai girma; a turanci muna yin 'I work as' ko 'I am responsible for'.
rule: Don hira game da fasalin aiki naka a turanci a matakin B1: 1) Yi amfani da present simple don nuna wani aiki na yanzu: 'I work as a...' (Ina aiki a matsayin...), 'I am responsible for...' (Na kan tsare...). 2) Don fasalin da ya gabata, yi amfani da 'used to' ko past simple: 'I used to work at...' / 'I worked at...'. 3) 'Have' yana nuna shekaru ko fasaha: 'I have five years of experience' (Ina shekaru biyar na fasaha). 4) Adjectives suka zama a gaba da nouns: 'I have strong communication skills' (ba 'skills strong' ba). 5) Yi amfani da 'in' don sectors ('experience in hospitality'), 'at' don companies ('at a hotel'), da 'as' don titles ('as a manager'). 6) A CV, muna yin bullet points tare da verbs a past ko present, ba cikin sentences da cikakken kalmomi ba.

concept_examples.text: I have five years of experience in customer service.
concept_examples.translation: Ina da shekaru biyar na fasaha a cikin kula da abokai.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ hæv faɪv jɪrz əv ɪkˈspɪriəns ɪn ˈkʌstəmər ˈsɜrvɪs/

concept_examples.text: I am responsible for managing the sales team.
concept_examples.translation: Na kan tsare da rage fasalin sabis.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ æm rɪˈspɑnsəbəl fər ˈmænɪdʒɪŋ ðə seɪlz tim/

concept_examples.text: She studied marketing at the university.
I would like to apply for the position of cashier.
concept_examples.translation: Ina son nuna niyya na nuna aiki a matsayin mai kasuwanci.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ wʊd laɪk tə əˈplaɪ fər ðə pəˈzɪʃən əv ˈkæʃɪr/

common_error.wrong: I have 30 years and I am graduated in marketing.
common_error.correct: I am 30 years old and I graduated in marketing.
common_error.correct_alt: I am 30 years old and I have a degree in marketing.
common_error.explanation: A cikin yare na Turanci, muna yin 'I am 30 years old' da 'I have a degree in', amma a turanci muna yin 'to be' don shekaru ('I am 30 years old') da 'am graduated' saboda 'graduate' ya zama active voice ('I graduated'). Don titles, muna yin 'have a degree in'. Wani kuskure ne ya yi yawa da yin 'old' bayan shekaru. Yi tana: 'I am + number + years old' da 'graduate from' ko 'have a degree in'.

levels.label: Talking about Personal Information
levels.translation: Magana game da bayanin shi na juna

examples.original: I am 28 years old.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ æm ˈtweɪti eɪt jɪrz oʊld/
examples.translation: Ina shekaru 28.
examples.note: Muna yin 'am' don shekaru, ba 'have' kamar yare na Turanci.

examples.original: I was born in Mexico City.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ wəz bɔrn ɪn ˈmɛksɪkoʊ ˈsɪti/
examples.translation: Na haifa a Birnin Mexico.
examples.note: Yi amfani da 'be born' a past, ba 'born' kawai. 'In' don birane.

examples.original: I live in Valencia, Spain.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ lɪv ɪn vəˈlɛnsiə, speɪn/
examples.translation: Ina rayuwarku a Valencia, Spain.
examples.note: Muna yin 'in' don birane da countries.

examples.original: I have a degree in business administration.

examples.original: I am proficient in English and Spanish.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ æm prəˈfɪʃənt ɪn ˈɪŋglɪʃ ənd ˈspænɪʃ/
examples.translation: Ina da fasaha mai girma na Turanci da Turanci.
examples.note: 'Proficient in' yana nuna mastery. Ba 'I am good in' ba.

examples.original: I studied computer science for four years.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ ˈstʌdid kəmˈpjutər ˈsaɪəns fər fɔr jɪrz/
examples.translation: Na koyi fasaha na fasaha na shekaru hudu.
examples.note: Yi amfani da 'study' + subject, da 'for' don duration.

examples.original: I worked as a sales assistant for two years.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ wɜrkt æz ə seɪlz əˈsɪstənt fər tu jɪrz/
examples.translation: Na aiki a matsayin mai sabis na shekaru biyu.
examples.note: Yi amfani da 'work as' + title, da 'for' + duration.

examples.original: Currently, I am working at a hotel.
examples.phonetic: /ˈkɜrəntli, aɪ æm ˈwɜrkɪŋ æt ə hoʊˈtɛl/
examples.translation: Yanzu, ina aiki a hotel.
examples.note: Yi amfani da present continuous don actions da yanzu.

examples.original: I am responsible for answering emails and managing bookings.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ æm rɪˈspɑnsəbəl fər ˈænsərɪŋ ˈimeɪlz ənd ˈmænɪdʒɪŋ ˈbʊkɪŋz/
examples.translation: Na kan tsare da amsa wasu takardu da rage fasalin sabis.
examples.note: 'Responsible for' + gerund (-ing). Ba 'responsible of' ba.

examples.translation: Na yi aiki a cikin kula da abokai da yanzu.
examples.note: 'Used to' yana nuna action da muna yi a gabata.

title: Discussing current events / Magana da sabon halayen da ke faruwa
bridge: A cikin Turanci, muna yin amfani da present perfect domin bayyana sabon halayen da suka faru ba tare da daidaitawa da lokaci ba, saboda haka 'has happened'. Domin fasaha da suka faru a lokaci mai zurfi, muna yin amfani da past simple, kamar 'announced yesterday'. Kuma fasaha mai yawa da ke faruwa a yau, muna yin amfani da present continuous, kamar 'is happening'. Wata kuskure ce mai yawa a cikin turanci, ko da yake cikin Hausa 'ya yi' da 'is happening', amma a Turanci, 'is happening' yana nufin fasaha da ke faruwa a yau. Saboda haka, 'is happening' ba zai yi amfani ba saboda wannan fasaha ba, ba tare da wata sabuwa fasaha ba.
rule: Don magana da sabon halayen a Turanci a matan B1: 1. Yi amfani da present perfect (have/has + participle) don fitar da sabon halayen ba tare da daidaitawa da lokaci ba: 'Scientists have discovered a new planet.' 2. Yi amfani da past simple don fasaha da suka faru a lokaci mai zurfi: 'They announced the result yesterday.' 3. Yi amfani da present continuous don fasaha da ke faruwa a yau: 'The government is debating the new law.' 4. Don bayyana ra'ayinka, Yi amfani da kalmomi kamar 'I think', 'In my opinion', 'I believe' da ajiya da wata sabuwa kalma. 5. Kalmomin muhimmi: 'headline', 'article', 'report', 'according to', 'latest', 'issue'.

concept_examples.text: The government has announced new measures to reduce pollution.
concept_examples.translation: Gaskiya, an gabatar da sabon tsarin da ke cire wasu abubuwa don rage zafin lafiya.
concept_examples.phonetic: ðə ˈɡʌvənmənt hæz əˈnaʊnst nuː ˈmɛʒərz tə rɪˈdjuːs pəˈluːʃən.

concept_examples.text: According to the news, the situation is improving slowly.
concept_examples.translation: Amsa da fasaha, halayen yana siye da yawa.
concept_examples.phonetic: əˈkɔːrdɪŋ tə ðə nuːz, ðə ˌsɪtʃuˈeɪʃən ɪz ɪmˈpruːvɪŋ ˈsloʊli.

concept_examples.text: I think the article was very biased.
concept_examples.translation: Ina tunanin wannan rubutu yana da wasu ra'ayoyi.
concept_examples.phonetic: aɪ θɪŋk ði ˈɑːrtɪkl wəz ˈveri ˈbaɪəst.

concept_examples.text: Have you heard about the election results?
concept_examples.translation: Ka ji wata abu game da sakamakon shugaban ƙasar?
concept_examples.phonetic: hæv juː hɜːrd əˈbaʊt ði ɪˈlɛkʃən rɪˈzʌlts?

common_error.wrong: The government has announced new measures yesterday.
common_error.correct: The government announced new measures yesterday.
common_error.correct_alt: The government has announced new measures. (sin tiempo específico)
common_error.explanation: An yarda da wannan kuskure saboda a cikin Hausa, muna iya cewa 'ya gabatar da sabuwa abu da yau' ko 'yesterday', amma a Turanci, ba zai yi amfani da present perfect tare da lokaci mai zurfi ba. Yi amfani da past simple don fasaha da suka faru a lokaci mai zurfi. Don 'yesterday', 'last week', da sauran lokuta, kada ka yi amfani da 'have/has'.

levels.label: Headlines and introductions
levels.translation: Sabbin fasaha da matakai na farko

examples.original: The economy is growing again.
examples.phonetic: ðə iˈkɒnəmi ɪz ˈɡroʊɪŋ əˈɡɛn.
examples.translation: Kasuwanci yana siye da yawa.
examples.note: Yi amfani da present continuous don bayyana fasaha da ke faruwa a yau.

examples.original: Scientists have found a new vaccine.
examples.phonetic: ˈsaɪəntɪsts hæv faʊnd ə nuː vækˈsiːn.
examples.translation: Masana ne suka sami sabuwa fasaha da ke cire wasu cututtuka.
examples.note: Present perfect yana amfani don fitar da sabuwa abu ba tare da daidaitawa da lokaci ba.

examples.original: Conflict in the region has escalated.
examples.phonetic: ˈkɒnflɪkt ɪn ðə ˈriːdʒən hæz ˈɛskəleɪtɪd.
examples.translation: Yanayin ya yi da yawa a yankin.
examples.note: Duba amfani da 'has' tare da mai suna.

examples.original: The accident happened at 8 p.m. last night.
examples.phonetic: ði ˈæksɪdənt ˈhæpənd æt eɪt piː ɛm læst naɪt.
examples.translation: Yanayin ya faru da safe na 8 da safe.
examples.note: Past simple yana amfani don fasaha da suka faru a lokaci mai zurfi.

examples.original: Meanwhile, the prime minister was talking to reporters.
examples.phonetic: ˈmiːnwaɪl, ðə praɪm ˈmɪnɪstər wəz ˈtɔːkɪŋ tə rɪˈpɔːrtərz.
examples.translation: A halin nan, shugaban ƙasar yana yin magana da masu labarai.
examples.note: Past continuous yana bayyana fasaha da ke faruwa a lokaci mai zurfi.

levels.label: Expressing opinions and reactions
levels.translation: Bayyana ra'ayoyi da fasaha da ke faru

examples.original: In my opinion, the government should react quickly.
examples.phonetic: ɪn maɪ əˈpɪnjən, ðə ˈɡʌvərmənt ʃʊd riˈækt ˈkwɪkli.
examples.translation: A ra'ayina, shugaban ƙasar ya kamata ya yi amfani da fasaha mai zurfi.
examples.note: Yi amfani da 'should' don bayyana shawara.

examples.original: I can't believe they decided that!
examples.phonetic: aɪ kænt bɪˈliːv ðeɪ dɪˈsaɪdɪd ðæt!
examples.translation: Ba zan iya gane ba in da suka yi wannan!
examples.note: Bayyana mamaki da 'can't believe' + past simple.

title: Cultural Differences and Misunderstandings / Farashin da Tsakanin Al’umma da Fadakarwa
bridge: A cikin Espanyol, muna nuna rashin jin damuwa ko mamaki a yadda da ya dace, while a cikin turanci, yana da alama da yin magana da yadda ya dace da yadda ya dace, kamar 'I think...' ko 'Maybe...'. Wata kuma, a turanci, fadakarwar da ake yi da yawa ne ta tambaya mai tabbatarwa ('Do you mean...?'), while a Espanyol, yana da alama da yin magana da yadda ya dace da yadda ya dace. Don haka, don wucewa da matsalar, ya kamata ka koyi yin tambaya mai tabbatarwa da kalmomin kamar 'What do you mean?' ko kusan yarda da yarda da ake yarda da ake yarda. Wannan ya kamata ya dace da yin amfani da fasaha na yau da gobe: a turanci, an yi amfani da fasaha mai yau da gobe don aiki masu cika, while a Espanyol, a yau da gobe, an yi amfani da fasaha mai yau da gobe don aiki masu cika.
rule: Don yin magana game da farashin da tsakanin al’umma da fadakarwa a turanci a matakin B1, ya kamata ka koyi: 1) Tambaya mai yin magana da yadda ya dace: 'Could you explain that?' ko 'Can you explain that?' a matsakaicin 'Explain that'. 2) Kalmomin da ake yi da yadda ya dace da rashin jin damuwa: 'I think', 'I feel', 'I guess' don kusan yarda da rashin jin damuwa. 3) Tambaya mai tabbatarwa: 'Do you mean...?', 'Are you saying...?' don tabbatar da abin da mai magana ya yi. 4) Amfani da fasaha mai yau da gobe don aiki masu cika: 'I misunderstood' (ba 'I have misunderstood' ko ba da ba da ba da ba da ba). Ka tsaya da wata kalma mai yarda da 'tener razón' (to be right, ba 'to have reason') da 'hacer falta' (to need, ba 'to make lack').

concept_examples.text: I thought you were coming at 7, but you came at 8.
concept_examples.translation: Na tsammani za ka zo da safe 7, amma ka zo da safe 8.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ θɔːt juː wɜːr ˈkʌmɪŋ æt ˈsɛvn bʌt juː keɪm æt eɪt/

concept_examples.text: Could you repeat that? I didn't understand.
concept_examples.translation: Zan iya kawo wannan? Ba zan fahimta ba.
concept_examples.phonetic: /kʊd juː rɪˈpiːt ðæt aɪ ˈdɪdnt ˌʌndərˈstænd/

concept_examples.text: In my culture, it's polite to take off your shoes.
concept_examples.translation: A al’ummarina, yana da alama da yin magana da yadda ya dace da yadda ya dace.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪn maɪ ˈkʌltʃər ɪts pəˈlaɪt tə teɪk ɒf jɔːr ʃuːz/

concept_examples.text: He said he'd call, but he didn't.
concept_examples.translation: Ya yi magana cewa zai kira, amma ba ya yi ba.
concept_examples.phonetic: /hiː sɛd hiːd kɔːl bʌt hiː ˈdɪdnt/

common_error.wrong: You have reason, but I think different.
common_error.correct: You're right, but I think differently.
common_error.correct_alt: You may be right, but I see it differently.
common_error.explanation: Matsala ta fito saboda a cikin Espanyol muna yarda da 'tener razón' (daidai da 'to have reason') da 'pensar diferente' (ba da adadin adadin). A turanci, an yi amfani da 'to be right' (ba 'to have reason') da adadin 'differently' (ba adadin 'different'). Don wucewa da wannan, ka koyi cewa 'reason' yana nufin 'motive', ba 'razon' a matsakaicin da ake yarda da ake yarda.

levels.label: Expressing Opinions Politely
levels.translation: Nuna ra’ayoyi da yadda ya dace

examples.original: I think that's a good idea.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ θɪŋk ðæts ə gʊd aɪˈdɪə/
examples.translation: Ina tsammanin wannan yana da kyau.
examples.note: Yi amfani da 'I think' a matsakaicin 'I believe' don kusan yarda da rashin jin damuwa a cikin wata.

examples.original: Maybe we could try another way.
examples.phonetic: /ˈmeɪbi wiː kʊd traɪ əˈnʌðər weɪ/
examples.translation: Maybe mun iya gwadawa da wata hanya mai zuwa.
examples.note: 'Maybe' yana da alama da rashin jin damuwa, kamar 'maybe' a cikin Espanyol.

examples.original: I'm not sure that's true.
examples.phonetic: /aɪm nɒt ʃʊə ðæts truː/
examples.translation: Ba zan tabbatar ba cewa wannan yana da alheri.
examples.note: A turanci, an yi amfani da 'not sure' don nuna rashin tabbatarwa ba tare da rashin jin damuwa ba.

examples.original: What do you mean by that?
examples.phonetic: /wɒt duː juː miːn baɪ ðæt/
examples.translation: Me ne ya nufi da wannan?
examples.note: Wannan tambaya mai yarda da rashin jin damuwa ce; ta fi 'What?' wanda zai iya zama mai yarda.

examples.original: Could you explain that more slowly?
examples.phonetic: /kʊd juː ɪkˈspleɪn ðæt mɔːr ˈsloʊli/
examples.translation: Zan iya kawo wannan da sauri?
examples.note: 'Could' yana da alama da yarda da rashin jin damuwa da 'can' don neman abubuwa.

examples.original: Do you mean the meeting is tomorrow?
examples.phonetic: /duː juː miːn ðə ˈmiːtɪŋ ɪz təˈmɒroʊ/
examples.translation: Me ne ya yi da cewa matsayi za a yi gobe?
examples.note: Yi amfani da 'Do you mean...?' don tabbatar da abin da ka fahimta.

examples.original: In Spain, people eat lunch late.
examples.phonetic: /ɪn speɪn ˈpiːpl iːt lʌntʃ leɪt/
examples.translation: A Espanya, mutane suna cin abinci da dare.
examples.note: Koyi yin amfani da 'in + country' don yin magana game da al’adunsu.

examples.original: That's very different from my culture.
examples.phonetic: /ðæts ˈvɛri ˈdɪfərənt frɒm maɪ ˈkʌltʃər/
examples.translation: Wannan yana da alama da rashin daidai da al’ummarina.
examples.note: 'Different from' yana da alama da yadda ya dace a turanci, ba 'different of'.

examples.original: We never do that in my country.
examples.phonetic: /wiː ˈnɛvər duː ðæt ɪn maɪ ˈkʌntri/
examples.translation: Ba muka yi wannan a kasar mu ba.
examples.note: Yi amfani da 'never' kafin kalmar mai aiki.

examples.original: It was a misunderstanding.
examples.phonetic: /ɪt wɒz ə ˌmɪsʌndərˈstændɪŋ/
examples.translation: Wannan fadakarwa ce.
examples.note: Kalma mai mahimmanci don wucewa da matsalar.
